# Intent one-pager
1. Problem (3 sentences max, in the business's words)
2. Who feels it (personas + weekly cost to them)
3. Current state (process, systems, manual effort) - each figure with a source file
4. Desired outcome (measurable; link to the KPI tree)
5. In scope / out of scope (systems, controls, autonomy level)
6. Constraints (regulatory, residency, budget, dates)
7. Assumptions (owner + date to confirm)
8. Open questions (owner)
